summary.en: Israel continues airstrikes and artillery against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon while occupying Haddatha under a cease-fire, and Hezbollah responds with guerrilla attacks and drone warfare. Lebanese President Aoun publicly demanded Israeli withdrawal and warned Iran to stop interfering in Lebanon’s affairs. Iraqi forces have struck a compromise with a powerful pro-Iran militia and are set to deploy today to the stronghold of the Iran-backed Kataeb Hezbollah. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel fortsetter luftangrep og artilleri mot Hizbollah-posisjoner i sørlige Libanon mens de okkuperer Haddatha under en våpenhvile, og Hizbollah svarer med geriljaangrep og dronekrigføring. Libanons president Aoun krevde offentlig israelsk tilbaketrekning og advarte Iran om å slutte å blande seg inn i Libanons saker. Iraks styrker har inngått et kompromiss med en mektig pro-iransk milits og skal i dag bli utplassert til festningen til den Iran-støttede Kataeb-Hizbollah. Konflikten forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
